'''Koki Kofuns''' (小木古墳群, ''Koki Kofungun'') are a group of [[kofun]] (ancient Kofuns) from the [[Kofun period]] located in the Koki district in the western part of {{ill|Komaki|en|Komaki|qid=Q389537|lt=Komaki|1=Komaki}}, {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|en|Aichi Prefecture|qid=Q80434|lt=Aichi Prefecture|1=Aichi Prefecture}}. Although no formal archaeological survey has been conducted, the artifacts unearthed suggest they date to the late {{ill|3rd century|en|3rd century|qid=Q8101|lt=3rd century|1=3rd century}} to the {{ill|4th century|en|4th century|qid=Q8099|lt=4th century|1=4th century}}.

==History==

* Late {{ill|3rd century|en|3rd century|qid=Q8101|lt=3rd century|1=3rd century}} to {{ill|4th century|en|4th century|qid=Q8099|lt=4th century|1=4th century}}: Construction of the Kofuns.
* {{ill|September 9|en|September 9|qid=Q2856|lt=September 9|1=September 9}}, {{ill|1987|en|1987|qid=Q2429|lt=1987|1=1987}} ({{ill|Shōwa|en|Shōwa|qid=Q398996|lt=Shōwa|1=Shōwa}} 62): The [[Utsunomiya Shrine|Utsunomiya Shrine Kofun]] ({{ill|Utsunomiya Shrine|lt=Utsunomiya Shrine|lt=Utsunomiya Shrine Kofun|ja|宇都宮神社古墳|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Utsunomiya Shrine Kofun|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宇都宮神社 (小牧市)}}) was designated as a tangible {{ill|Cultural property|en|Cultural property|qid=Q2065736|lt=Cultural property|1=Cultural property}} by {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|en|Aichi Prefecture|qid=Q80434|lt=Aichi Prefecture|1=Aichi Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|August 15|en|August 15|qid=Q2774|lt=August 15|1=August 15}}, {{ill|1992|en|1992|qid=Q2060|lt=1992|1=1992}} ([[:en:Heisei|Heisei]] 4): The Kōyashiki Kofun was designated as a cultural property by [[Komaki City]].

==Notable Kofuns==

* {{ill|Utsunomiya Shrine|lt=Utsunomiya Shrine|lt=Utsunomiya Shrine Kofun|ja|宇都宮神社古墳|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Utsunomiya Shrine Kofun|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宇都宮神社 (小牧市)}}
* Jōonji Kofun
* {{ill|Kōyashiki Kofun|ja|甲屋敷古墳|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōyashiki Kofun|qq=}}
* Higashi-no-Miya Kofun

===Destroyed Kofuns===

* Kōyashiki No. 2 Kofun
* Tennozan Kofun

==Location==

* Koki 2-chome and 3-chome, {{ill|Komaki|en|Komaki|qid=Q389537|lt=Komaki|1=Komaki}}, {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|en|Aichi Prefecture|qid=Q80434|lt=Aichi Prefecture|1=Aichi Prefecture}}.

==Access==

* Alight at the Koki {{ill|Bus stop|en|Bus stop|qid=Q953806|lt=Bus stop|1=Bus stop}} via {{ill|Meitetsu Bus|en|Meitetsu Bus|qid=Q6810397|lt=Meitetsu Bus|1=Meitetsu Bus}}.

==See Also==

* {{ill|Oda Ido Site|ja|織田井戸遺跡|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Oda Ido Site|qq=}} – An archaeological site near the Kofuns, spanning from the [[Jōmon period]] to the {{ill|Yayoi period|en|Yayoi period|qid=Q207858|lt=Yayoi period|1=Yayoi period}}.

==External Links==

* [http://www.city.komaki.aichi.jp/admin/event_1/events/bunkazai/2/1/13694.html Koki Kofuns] (Komaki City website)

'''Koki Kofun Group''' (小木古墳群) is a group of {{ill|Kofun|en|Kofun|qid=Q1141225|lt=Kofun|1=Kofun}} from the {{ill|Kofun period|en|Kofun period|qid=Q459939|lt=Kofun Period|1=Kofun period}} located in the Koki district in the western part of {{ill|Komaki|en|Komaki|qid=Q389537|lt=Komaki City|1=Komaki}}, {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|en|Aichi Prefecture|qid=Q80434|lt=Aichi Prefecture|1=Aichi Prefecture}}. Although no comprehensive investigation has been conducted, the excavated artifacts are believed to date from the late {{ill|3rd century|en|3rd century|qid=Q8101|lt=3rd century|1=3rd century}} to around the {{ill|4th century|en|4th century|qid=Q8099|lt=4th century|1=4th century}}.

* {{ill|1992|en|1992|qid=Q2060|lt=1992|1=1992}} ({{ill|Heisei era|en|Heisei era|qid=Q234510|lt=Heisei|1=Heisei era}} 4) {{ill|August 15|en|August 15|qid=Q2774|lt=August 15|1=August 15}} – The {{ill|Koyashiki Kofun|ja|甲屋敷古墳|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Koyashiki Kofun|1=Kōyashiki Kofun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11577730}} was designated as a {{ill|Historic site|en|Historic site|qid=Q1081138|lt=Historic site of Japan|1=Historic site}}} by {{ill|Komaki|en|Komaki|qid=Q389537|lt=Komaki City|1=Komaki}}.
